HomePage.title: Welcome
HomePage.journey1: I write about programming and automation, building useful apps, working with data, and exploring technology. My curiosity for code sparked in 2020 with <phpNative>PHP Native</phpNative>, quickly expanding to <javascript>JavaScript</javascript> the following year.
HomePage.journey2: By 2022, I was deep in the modern web ecosystem, combining <tailwind>Tailwind CSS</tailwind>, <react>React</react>, and <git>Git</git> across real projects. In 2023, I stepped into Web3—experimenting with <automationBots>automation bots</automationBots> to streamline blockchain airdrop tasks, unpacking stacks and workflows through reverse engineering until the system design in use was obvious. Today, I'm strengthening my theoretical CS foundations as a student at <university>Bina Sarana Informatika</university>.
HomePage.connectDescription: I'm always open to interesting projects and collaborations. Whether you have a question, want to discuss an idea, or just say hello, feel free to reach out.

ProjectsPage.title: Projects
ProjectsPage.description: Here are some of my recent projects. Each project represents a learning journey and a step forward in my development skills.
ProjectsPage.project1Description: A personal portfolio website showcasing my projects and skills. Built with modern web technologies and best practices.
ProjectsPage.project2Description: An automation bot for blockchain airdrop tasks. Streamlines repetitive tasks and improves efficiency.
ProjectsPage.project3Description: A game development project exploring game mechanics and player interactions. Built with Unity and C#.

NowPage.title: What I'm doing now
NowPage.activity3: Exploring the <blockchain>Blockchain ecosystem</blockchain> and abusing airdrops for fun to learn about decentralized finance.
NowPage.activity4: Deep diving into <devops>DevOps</devops> practices, specifically focusing on GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker containerization.
NowPage.activity5: Hands-on experience <deployment>deploying</deployment> models and <mlpipelines>building machine learning pipelines</mlpipelines>—from training and evaluation to serving them reliably in production.
NowPage.techStackDescription: Here are the technologies and tools I work with or am currently learning:
NowPage.tech1: My main stack is the full <javascript>JavaScript</javascript> ecosystem: <frontend>frontend</frontend> with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, plus backend with <elysia>ElysiaJS</elysia> on <bun>Bun</bun>, <drizzle>Drizzle ORM</drizzle>, and MySQL/Postgres.
NowPage.tech2: I also work with <python>Python</python> for scripting and tooling. I'm <learning>currently on a deep dive into</learning> <golang>Go</golang>.
NowPage.tech3: Running <arch>Arch Linux</arch> with <hyprland>Hyprland</hyprland> as my workspace environment.
